newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morocco's railroad wins French credit line - sources.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's railroad wins French credit line - sources.

text.p: A bank group headed by Banque Nationale de Paris has agreed to extend a 130 million franc credit line to finance part of a large investment programme launched by Morocco's Office National des Chemins de Fer Marocains (ONCF), banking sources said on Tuesday.
The consortium also includes Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie (BMCE) and the Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce (BMC), they said.

The agreement was signed in Paris on December 18. In May ONCF said it was also discussing loans with international financial institutions, including the World Bank, the African Development Bank (ADB) and the European Investment Bank (EIB).
